## 9d0a6f959321

**Classification: reproduced curriculum shortcut and 8-neighbor support restriction.**

I sampled 600 ordinary inputs (`easy`, `medium`, and `hard`; `seed=sample_index=1..200`). An 8-connected-component rival matched the selected 4-connected Racket rule on all 600, and none of the generated inputs placed same-color components in diagonal contact. The generator's own validator accepts such cases, so this is a curriculum restriction rather than a rule-lawfulness question.

A constructed 6×6 input passes `self_check` but contains two orange 4-connected components that touch only diagonally. The intended 4-connected Racket output recolors them separately; the 8-connected rival recolors the union as one object. `checks/audit/9d0a6f959321/counterexample.json` records the exact input, outputs, source/rule hashes, apply command, and validator result; `checks/audit/9d0a6f959321/racket.json` is the selected Racket output.

The generator also silently accepts an unknown override key. No source was modified because this was audit-only.

triage.reason: Accepted as reviewer-reported source-bound audit evidence. 9d0a6f959321: same-color diagonal contact absent from 600 defaults permits an 8-connectivity shortcut; validator-clean Racket counterexample retained. 2361d6aa42c3: straight-only sampler misses accepted canonical bent paths; shortcut/counterexample retained. Both accept unknown overrides. Findings only; audit targets unchanged.
